Predicates:
PublishedBy(x, y) ::: x was published by y.
InLanguage(x, y) ::: x is in language y.
TranslatedFrom(x, y) ::: x was translated from language y.
SpecializesIn(z, y) ::: z specializes in y.
Premises:
∀x (PublishedBy(x, y) → SpecializesIn(y, foreign literature)) ::: All books published by New Vessel Press are in foreign literature.
∀x (PublishedBy(x, newVesselPress)) ::: All books published by New Vessel Press are in English.

PublishedBy(NeapolitanChronicles, newVesselPress)
TranslatedFrom(NeapolitanChronicles, Italian)
